## NASA imagery (public domain)

Sourced from the NASA Image and Video Library (images.nasa.gov). NASA media
is generally not copyrighted and may be used freely; processed here via
`crop + darken` for terminal readability.

- `hyperspace.jpg` — "A Hubble Sky Full of Stars", globular cluster IC 4499,
  NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope. NASA ID: `GSFC_20171208_Archive_e000256`
- `dune.jpg` — Namib Desert sand sea near the Atlantic coast, photographed
  from the International Space Station. NASA ID: `iss073e0511487`
